    Custom area

    Combine LSOAs (small statistical areas of about 1,500 residents) into a custom area, with counts summed and rates population-weighted. Select an LSOA on the map to add or remove it.

    Select your geography and indicators below to download a custom CSV dataset.

    1Which areas?

    Choose one or more sizes of area. Each size gets its own file, with one row for each area.

    2Where?

    Choose all of London, one ICB, or one LA.

    3Which indicators?

    Each indicator you choose becomes one column. Search for one, choose a whole group with the box beside its name, or start from a ready-made set.
